## Introduction

Physical inactivity and obesity are important public health concerns in the United States.

This report examines the relationship between leisure-time physical inactivity and obesity among U.S. adults.

### Research Question

How is leisure-time physical inactivity associated with obesity among U.S. adults, and does this relationship differ by age and sex?

## Methods

This study will use data from the 2024 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS).

The analysis will include descriptive statistics,survey-weighted comparisons,and regression analysis.
